t: In front of you is the Victoria Memorial, standing at the end of The Mall before Buckingham Palace. It honours Queen Victoria, who reigned for over sixty-three years. The sculptor was Sir Thomas Brock, regarded in his day as Britain's leading sculptor. It was designed in 1901 and unveiled on the sixteenth of May 1911, though it wasn't finished until 1924. It was the centrepiece of a larger scheme by the architect Sir Aston Webb, which also created the Queen's Gardens and gave Buckingham Palace its refaced front.
